parsed.name: OpenFlexure 电动位移台
parsed.description: 一种通过串口控制的电动位移台，通常由步进电机驱动，用于多轴样品或光学部件定位。它可执行相对/绝对移动、Z 轴对焦扫描、线性扫描以及基于限位的回零，常用于显微成像、样品定位和重复扫描实验。
parsed.description_en: A serial-controlled motorized translation stage, typically driven by stepper motors, for multi-axis positioning of samples or optical components. It supports relative/absolute motion, Z-axis focus scans, linear scans, and endstop-based homing, and is commonly used in microscopy, sample positioning, and repeatable scanning experiments.
